arrived: Curious. Told Jen about the third-set faults from Saturday.
session_narrative: Jen watched me serve for a while and said the toss was drifting behind me on second serve, which was why I was pushing them long or into the tape. take_away: New toss feels wrong. Trust the process I guess. Two weeks.
